_about: FICTIONAL sample. The owner's stated investing rules, in their own words, with dates. A rule here overrides the financial picture where they differ. Claude creates data/investor-profile.json from a few short questions on first run.

rules.rule: Retirement money; no withdrawals for 25+ years.
rules.owner_words: I won't touch the IRA until I retire.
rules.implication: Can hold mostly stocks and ride out deep falls.

rules.rule: Up to half of the brokerage account may be needed for a goal in about 5 years.
rules.owner_words: I might use some of it for a big purchase in a few years.
rules.implication: Treat up to 50% of the brokerage account as near-term money in the account-fit check.

rules.rule: No single company above 10% of long-term investments.
rules.owner_words: I don't want any one stock to sink me.
rules.implication: Caps the size range for every stock at 10%.

open_questions: How much of the brokerage account is the goal money: closer to 25% or 50%?
